notes: Each output file is an independent STEP session: MsgSeqNum starts at 1.

ApplSeqNum is renumbered continuously per output channel; the source files carry sparse per-security subsets of the original exchange channel sequence, so cross-security order is reconstructed by TransactTime (ties broken deterministically by security code).

Source product-status records (OrdType=S, code E/I/O/J/C) are emitted as UB001 with ExecType=S and Text(58)=<code>. This is an extension: IS120 0.62 defines ExecType 0/4/F only and documents UB001 for SecurityType=13 (bond non-matching).
TradingPhaseCode is derived from exchange time; the source snapshot files do not carry product status.
MDEntryType=9 (daily VWAP) is computed as cumulative amount / cumulative volume; it is not present in the source snapshot columns.
Source order files omit some marketable orders (trades may reference order IDs with no corresponding add record). Trades are emitted with the references exactly as supplied.
Symbol(55), MemberID(10211) and TraderCode(10215) are not present in the source; they are omitted rather than emitted empty, because strict FIX parsers reject empty field values.
